layout_strategy.container: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 lg:py-24
layout_strategy.grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 lg:gap-16 items-start

surface_styles.order_summary: bg-zinc-950/50 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
surface_styles.input_field: bg-zinc-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/50 focus:border-emerald-500/50 transition-all
surface_styles.payment_method_card: relative flex flex-col items-start p-6 border border-white/10 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/30 hover:bg-zinc-900/80 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-200
surface_styles.payment_method_card_active: relative flex flex-col items-start p-6 border-2 border-emerald-500 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)]
surface_styles.logged_in_card: flex items-center space-x-4 p-4 border border-white/10 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/50

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a distinct hover state. Buttons should scale slightly (scale-[1.02]) and brighten.
motion_and_interaction.focus_states: High contrast focus rings. Inputs ring-2 ring-emerald-500/50.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use Lucide Loader2 icon with animate-spin inside the submit button. Disable button and dim opacity during load.

form.structure: 2-column grid for short fields (Nome, Sobrenome, CPF, Telefone), full-width for Email and Senhas.
form.error_messages: text-sm text-red-500 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1

upgrade_mode.description: When ?upgrade=true is present, hide the full registration form. Show a compact user profile summary card.
upgrade_mode.ui: Avatar (or initial), Name, Email, and a small badge 'Conta Verificada'. Reduces cognitive load.

gateway_selection.description: Tabs or Bento-style cards for SyncPay (PIX only) or Asaas (PIX, Boleto, Cartão).
gateway_selection.icons: Use Lucide icons: QrCode (PIX), Receipt (Boleto), CreditCard (Cartão).

order_summary.plan_details: Show Plan Name prominently (H3), Price/cycle, and a list of key features/limits with check icons.
order_summary.coupon: Input group with nested 'Aplicar' button. Text should turn emerald when a valid coupon is applied.
order_summary.total: Massive text for Total Price (text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white).
order_summary.trust_signals: Below the button: Secure SSL badge (Lucide ShieldCheck + Lock), 'Pagamento 100% Seguro', 'Criptografia de ponta a ponta', small and muted.

checkout_button.style: w-full bg-[#0aa876] hover:bg-[#088c62] text-white h-16 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between px-6 text-lg font-bold shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(10,168,118,0.39)] transition-all
checkout_button.content: Left: 'Confirmar Pagamento' + Lock Icon. Right: 'R$ Total'.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements must have data-testid. Kebab-case, role-based.

media.instructions: No external images required. Use pure CSS, borders, blur, and Lucide Icons to create a highly professional, developer-grade UI.
